title: Archive through March 30, 2004 - Anonymous (Tuesday, March 30, 2004 - 09:21 pm)
content: It was a weekend and I went to a club with my friends. In this club, we got MDMA-Pills (XTC) and I took two of them. After a short time, my trip started and I felt very good because it was a good trip. I felt happy and a strong feeling of love and being loved. After a short while a friend of mine and I decided to leave the club to smoke a joint in his car. After smoking, some kind of "supernatural" force pushed me into the seat. As I opened my eyes, the surrounding out of the car had turned into a thick brown mass or slime. Then the interior of the car vanished and many voices seem to talk to me, but I could not understand anything. My mind, by the way was all clear. Suddenly I felt something strange, something like a warm flux in the near of my solar plexus. I left my body for a short while just to return into the body of a soldier lying in hole on a battle field. I felt a strong pain in my right leg. The first time I was really frightened because it seemed so real to me. Everywhere were dead bodies, explosions and shots of automatic guns. After a short while, I left this body to return to my own. My friend sat the whole time besides me and he told me that I explained every detail to him during this experience. Since that experience, I got visions of the future sometimes, which proved themselves to be real.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Left own body briefly, then returned into the body of a soldier lying in a hole on a battlefield, then returned to own body.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described a 'supernatural force' pushing them into the seat; later felt a 'warm flux' near the solar plexus before leaving the body.

environment.environment_other_detail: Outside the car turned into a thick brown mass or slime; later found themselves in a battlefield with dead bodies, explosions, and automatic gunfire.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Left own body briefly, entered another body (a soldier), then left that body and returned to own.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drug intoxication (took two MDMA/XTC pills; later smoked a joint).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Entered another body (a soldier) and experienced a battlefield scene; reported later having future visions that proved real.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Drug experience began with euphoria/love, then altered environment (brown slime), voices, sensation at solar plexus, leaving body, entering soldier body, then returning to own body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred during MDMA (XTC) and cannabis use; perception of being pushed by a 'supernatural force'; environment outside car became 'thick brown mass or slime'; voices speaking unintelligibly; temporary shift into another body (a soldier) with pain and battlefield imagery; friend reported the experiencer narrated details aloud during the episode; afterward, occasional future visions that proved real.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "supernatural" force pushed me into the seat. As I opened my eyes, the surrounding out of the car had turned into a thick brown mass or slime.
